mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gn_user (id, username, password, nickname, bio, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, '', 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE gn_user SET nickname = #{nickname}, bio = #{bio}, avatar = #{avatar}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
